subject: general
question: Who among the following has been appointed as the Private Secretary to the Prime Minister Narendra Modi in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nidhi Tewari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nidhi Tewari** was appointed as the Private Secretary to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in March 2025.
 
• She is a senior Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer, known for her distinguished service and expertise in administrative roles.
 
• The role of Private Secretary to the Prime Minister is critical, involving coordination, policy advisory, and administrative management at the highest level of government.
 
• Nidhi Tewari’s appointment reflects the government’s trust in experienced bureaucrats to handle sensitive and high-responsibility positions.
 
• Her appointment was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC), which oversees high-level bureaucratic appointments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**:

 
 
• The ACC is responsible for appointments to top administrative posts in the Government of India.
 
• It is chaired by the Prime Minister and includes the Minister of Home Affairs.
 
 
 
• **Role of a Private Secretary to the PM**:
 
 
• The Private Secretary acts as a liaison between the Prime Minister and various departments and agencies.
 
• The role involves handling sensitive correspondence, scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication within the government.
 
 
 
• **Indian Administrative Service (IAS)**:
 
 
• The IAS is one of the premier civil services in India, responsible for implementing policies and managing administrative functions at various levels.
 
• IAS officers hold key positions such as District Magistrates, Secretaries to the Government, and Heads of Departments.
 
 
 
• **Process of High-Level Appointments**:
 
 
• High-level appointments in the Indian government are conducted with the approval of the ACC to ensure merit, transparency, and suitability for the role.
 
• Such appointments are often based on the officer’s track record, expertise, and experience in handling critical responsibilities.
